title: Extract shared execution-integrity mechanics without merging orchestration and recovery semantics
claim: Project Runner and WIP do not support one shared execution/recovery state machine. Exact schema comparison supports a narrower hypothesis: a neutral effect-integrity envelope may be reusable for target/precondition binding, post-effect ambiguity, readback evidence, and reconcile-before-retry while Runner retains orchestration/lease/budget semantics and WIP retains workspace/checkpoint/recovery semantics.
preserved_boundaries: Project Runner remains owner of work graph, dispatch, budgets, backend capability, target authority, leases, and completion semantics.
WIP remains owner of workspace recovery cadence, checkpoint history, continuation surfaces, and ambiguous-effect recovery workflow.
A shared contract may define mechanical fields/states but may not make either repository authoritative over the other.
promotion_evidence: Project Runner work-unit schema blob 65fd4f1af1812c280cbec0726a55b61b6ff02e76 defines execution status independently from WIP operation events.
Project Runner GitHub backend blob 833915398626c091a5df1dcc96504a7a12e7325f binds expected head/blob preconditions and post-write readback.
Project Runner verification blob e4f0453404013cbfe26882ea4805ae2fb3ce25aa uses VERIFYING, COMPLETE, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, and SUPERSEDED after backend execution.
WIP operation-event schema blob 66f9b5103e9ecc114feb9cb8fa6cebdc34082c2d defines PREPARED, ATTEMPTED, VERIFIED, FAILED, AMBIGUOUS, and RECONCILED with expected precondition and effect receipt.
WIP HEAD schema blob 7f94e4ea2358926fb3f2bf248cd3cb7600e246cd provides generation concurrency independently of Runner lease fencing.
rejection_conditions: The proposed common contract requires Project Runner-specific scheduling semantics.
The proposed common contract requires WIP-specific workspace/checkpoint lifecycle semantics.
Adapters needed to share the contract exceed the duplicated implementation removed.
A common state vocabulary creates ambiguity between execution completion and recovery reconciliation.
Either project loses a viable standalone path.

critical_objections: The initial 'execution integrity' label was too broad: lease/fencing and workspace recovery solve different failure domains.
A generic library is still premature; the current evidence supports only an interchange envelope experiment.
The envelope must preserve source-native state and permit standalone operation or it will become semantic compression.

notes: Experiment result so far: PARTIAL_SUPPORT_NARROWED; full shared state machine rejected, small effect-integrity envelope remains live.
